parole.significato: The official currency of Thailand, equal to 100 satang.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai บาท (bàat), from Pali pāda (quarter of a larger valued coin), ultimately from Sanskrit पाद (quarter).

parole.significato: A Thai Buddhist monument similar to a stupa.
parole.testo: From Thai เจดีย์ (jee-dii), from Pali cetiya (Devanagari spelling: चेतिय (cetiya)), from Sanskrit चैत्य (caitya, “hall, temple, or place of worship”).
